headlines.title: Datadog (DDOG) Stock Could Still Be Undervalued As AI Hopes Swing
headlines.summary: Datadog shares have swung sharply in recent months, and the question now is whether the current US$174.60 price can still be explained by the cash the business is expected to generate. With sentiment pulled around by AI excitement and sector-wide worries, the key issue is how that market mood lines up with the company’s underlying cash flows. Over the past 3 years, Datadog has delivered a total share price gain of 68.

headlines.title: Datadog Just Dropped 34% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysDatadog stock fell 34% in a week, first in a software selloff that also hit ServiceNow and Cloudflare, then on a flat fourth-quarter outlook. That outlook assumes Datadog’s largest customer, an AI company, pays only its minimum; growth from everyone else is guided to the low to mid-30s.

headlines.title: Datadog Q3 Earnings & Revenues Surpass Estimates, Both Rise Y/Y
headlines.summary: DDOG's Q3 EPS rises 47.3% and revenues climb 35.2%, beating estimates as AI adoption widens. Q4 guidance assumes its largest customer's minimum commitment.

headlines.title: DDOG Q3 Earnings Call Highlights AI Growth and Customer Renewals
headlines.summary: Datadog's Q3 revenues surge 35%, with adjusted EPS beating estimates, but AI customer discounts and cautious Q4 guidance temper its growth outlook.

description: Datadog, Inc. operates an observability and security platform for cloud applications in the United States and internationally. The company's products comprise infrastructure and application performance monitoring, log management, observability pipelines, synthetics, real user monitoring, product analytics, continuous profiler, database monitoring, data observability, LLM observability, error tracking, network monitoring, incident response, workflow automation and App builder, event management, bits AI SRE, cloud cost management, cloud security, code security, cloud SIEM, threat management, sensitive data scanner, and CI visibility. Datadog, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in New York, New York.
